output.review_comment: The code correctly passes all tests, but exhibits a behavior contradiction: the docstring describes pure "graduated pricing" where "every unit is charged at the price of the tier that its own position falls in." However, the implementation uses volume pricing for the last tier (applying that tier's rate to all units when quantity reaches it). For quantity=600 in the test, this yields 90,000 (600 × 150) rather than 120,000 (graduated). Update the docstring to clarify that quantities reaching the last open-ended tier receive volume pricing rather than graduated pricing.
